recordings.hostname_method: recording-time rewrite of the Host: value (pty wrapper; no namespace, no post-render overlay; XD-271)
recordings.note: Rendered with vhs 0.11.0 (VHS_NO_SANDBOX) from recordings/quickstart.tape at v0.22.0 and the novomodelo-cli-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu release (archive sha256 235ff225…, extracted executable sha256 5c057b4d…). The novomodelo on the recording shell's PATH was a wrapper that ran that executable on a pty (script -qfec) and replaced the machine's hostname with novomodelo-demo, of the same length, in its output, so colours and progress bars are the binary's own; the GIF is vhs's output unchanged (684 frames, 27.36 s).
